comment: Browser-parity fixtures of phase 3 (phase-3 spec 5.2): fixtures/p3/<area>/<name>.html with a <name>.json sidecar. Each area is owned by the package that writes its fixtures; BrowserParityTest runs every fixture of every area, BrowserFixtures.ManifestAndReferencesAreConsistent checks that each area directory is listed here. References: node tools/htmlui/render-reference.mjs --fixtures <area|area/name>.

testkit.content: the harness's self-tests: a fixture that must match, offsets inside and outside the tolerance, every step kind

values.content: units, colors, fonts, line-height: normal, logical properties

cascade.content: !important, CSS-wide keywords, selectors, pseudo-elements, counters, list markers

selectors.content: :root, :is(), :where(), :has(), focus pseudo-classes, form states, attribute selectors, :nth-child(of S), :empty

paint.content: borders, radii, outline, opacity groups, stacking, backgrounds, masks, object-fit

layout.content: fixed, sticky, overflow, box and flex parity

video.content: <video>: paused frames after a seek (object-fit, object-position, rounded content) and the poster; the frames are bit-exact AV1 on both sides, the difference is the YUV->RGB conversion

property.content: registered custom properties (@property): transitions and keyframes of typed custom properties, inherited and non-inherited lookups, invalid values at computed-value time, @starting-style, allow-discrete, the unregistered fallback

defaults.comment: The strict metric of spec 5.2 and the box tolerance; a sidecar's "tolerance" may override them only with a "comment" saying why.
